description: This script sets up a file-watching process using chokidar to monitor specific paths for changes, and manages spawning and restarting a Node.js process as part of a development workflow. It handles signals for graceful shutdown and restart, and references internal modules for path relevance checks and running watched paths.

methods.name: buildRunnerArgs
methods.description: Builds the argument array for spawning the runner process, including the runner script and additional args.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: normalizes file paths to use forward slashes and removes leading './'.

methods.name: resolveRepoPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path relative to the current working directory, returning a normalized path.

methods.name: isIgnoredWatchPath
methods.description: Determines whether a given watch path should be ignored based on its relevance to the run node path logic.

methods.name: runWatchMain
methods.description: Main function that sets up the watcher, manages the process lifecycle, and handles restart/shutdown logic.
